```{r extract disability vars from US individuals level}
        # Function to check if a package is installed and install it if necessary
            check_and_install <- function(package) {
            if (!require(package, character.only = TRUE)) {
                install.packages(package, dependencies = TRUE, type = "binary")
                if (!require(package, character.only = TRUE)) {
                install.packages(package, dependencies = TRUE, type = "source", INSTALL_opts = "--no-multiarch")
                library(package, character.only = TRUE)
                }
            }
            }
            
            # Check and install necessary packages
            check_and_install("haven")
            check_and_install("dplyr")
            check_and_install("tidyr")
            check_and_install("foreach")

        #  // this program returns all variable names with the wave prefix
            getVars <- function(arg1, arg2) {
            if (arg2== "") {
                wavemyvars <- arg1
            } else if (arg1 != "" & !is.null(arg2)) {
                # Split the string into separate elements
                wavemyvar <- strsplit(arg1, " ")[[1]]
                # Add the prefix "*_" to each element
                wavemyvar_prefix <- paste0(arg2,"_", wavemyvar)  
                # Concatenate the elements back into a single string
                wavemyvars <- paste(wavemyvar_prefix, collapse = " ")
            }  else {
                wavemyvars <- ""
            }
            return(wavemyvars)
            }

        # // this program to returns  which variables exist in this wave
            getExistingVars <- function(vars, df) {
            existingVars <- c()
            for (var in vars) {
                if (var %in% colnames(df)) {
                existingVars <- c(existingVars, var)
                }
            }
            return(existingVars)
            }

        # Split the wave string into individual letters
            allWaves <- strsplit(allWaves, " ")[[1]]

        # Loop through each wave
            for (wave in allWaves) {
            # Find the wave number (letter corresponding to the wave)
            waveno <- which(strsplit("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz", "")[[1]] == wave)
            
            # find the wave household vars  
            wavehhvars <- getVars(hhvars, wave)
            
            # find the wave individual vars
            waveindvars <- getVars(indvars, wave)
            
            # find the wave all individual vars
            waveindallvars <- getVars(indallvars, wave)
            
            # find the wave child vars
            wavechvars <- getVars(chvars, wave)
            
            # find the wave youth vars
            waveyouthvars <- getVars(youthvars, wave)
            
            # open the the household level file with the required variable
            hhresp_dat <- read_tsv(paste0(ukhls, "/", wave, "_hhresp.tab"))
            
            vars_to_check <- c(paste0(wave, "_hidp"), wavehhvars)
            vars_to_check <- unlist(strsplit(vars_to_check, " "))
            
            # get the existing variables using the getExistingVars function
            existingVars <- getExistingVars(vars_to_check, hhresp_dat)
            
            # keep only the existing variables in the data frame
            df_hhresp <- hhresp_dat %>% select(all_of(existingVars))
        
            # check if individual, child, or youth variables are required
            if (!is.null(indvars) || !is.null(chvars) || !is.null(youthvars)) {
                # if any individual variable is required, first merge INDALL keeping the pidp
                indall_data <- right_join(df_hhresp, read_tsv(paste0(ukhls, "/", wave, "_indall.tab")), by = paste0(wave, "_hidp"))
    
                    cat("After indall merge:\n")
                    print(table(indall_data$j_age_dv[indall_data$j_age_dv < 16]))

                # drop rows where pidp is missing (loose households with no individuals)
                indall_data <- indall_data[!is.na(indall_data$pidp), ]
                
                # get the existing variables using the getExistingVars function
                vars_to_check <- c("pidp", paste0(wave, "_hidp"), wavehhvars, waveindallvars)
                vars_to_check <- unlist(strsplit(vars_to_check, " "))
                existingVars <- getExistingVars(vars_to_check, indall_data)
                
                # keep only the existing variables in the data frame
                df_alldata <- indall_data %>% select(all_of(existingVars))
                
                # add any requested individual variables
                if (!is.null(indvars)){
                # Remove the duplicate variable from df_indresp before merging to avoid any suffix being added
                df_indresp <- read_tsv(paste0(ukhls, "/", wave, "_indresp.tab"))
                df_indresp <- df_indresp[ , !names(df_indresp) %in% names(df_alldata) | names(df_indresp) == "pidp"]
                
                indvars_dat <- merge(df_alldata, df_indresp, by = "pidp", all = TRUE)

                    cat("After indresp merge:\n")
                    print(table(indvars_dat$j_age_dv[indvars_dat$j_age_dv < 16]))
                
                # get the existing variables using the getExistingVars function
                vars_to_check <- c("pidp", paste0(wave, "_hidp"), wavehhvars, waveindvars, waveyouthvars, wavechvars, waveindallvars)
                vars_to_check <- unlist(strsplit(vars_to_check, " "))
                existingVars <- getExistingVars(vars_to_check, indvars_dat)
                
                # keep only the existing variables in the data frame
                df_alldata <- indvars_dat %>% select(all_of(existingVars))
                }
            
            # add any requested youth variables
                if (!is.null(waveyouthvars)){
                # remove the duplicate variable from df_youth before merging to avoid any suffix being added
                df_youth <- read_tsv(paste0(ukhls, "/", wave, "_youth.tab"))
                df_youth <- df_youth[ , !names(df_youth) %in% names(df_alldata) | names(df_youth) == "pidp"]
                
                youth_dat <- merge(df_alldata, df_youth, by = "pidp", all = TRUE)

                cat("After youth merge:\n")
                    print(table(youth_dat$j_age_dv[youth_dat$j_age_dv < 16]))
                
                # get the existing variables using the getExistingVars function
                vars_to_check <- c("pidp", paste0( wave, "_hidp"), wavehhvars, waveindvars, waveyouthvars, wavechvars, waveindallvars)
                vars_to_check <- unlist(strsplit(vars_to_check, " "))
                existingVars <- getExistingVars(vars_to_check, youth_dat)
                
                # keep only the existing variables in the data frame
                df_alldata <- youth_dat %>% select(all_of(existingVars))
                }
            
            # add any requested child variables
                if (!is.null(wavechvars)){
                df_child <- read_tsv(paste0(ukhls, "/", wave, "_child.tab"))
                df_child <- df_child[ , !names(df_child) %in% names(df_alldata) | names(df_child) == "pidp"]
                child_dat <- merge(df_alldata, df_child, by = "pidp", all = TRUE)
                    
                    cat("After child merge:\n")
                    print(table(child_dat$j_age_dv[child_dat$j_age_dv < 16]))
            # Get the existing variables using the getExistingVars function
                vars_to_check <- c("pidp", paste0(wave, "_hidp"), wavehhvars, waveindvars, waveyouthvars, wavechvars, waveindallvars)
                existingVars <- getExistingVars(unlist(strsplit(vars_to_check, " ")), child_dat)
                
                # Keep only the existing variables in the data frame
                df_alldata <- child_dat %>% select(all_of(existingVars))
                }
            }	
            cat("Final df_alldata before save:\n")
            print(table(df_alldata$j_age_dv[df_alldata$j_age_dv < 16]))
        # Save the file that was created
            saveRDS(df_alldata, file = paste0("temp_", wave, ".rds"))

            }

    df_wavedat <- readRDS(paste0("temp_", wave, ".rds"))
    cat("After readRDS:\n")
    print(table(df_wavedat$j_age_dv[df_wavedat$j_age_dv < 16]))

        # Initialize an empty dataframe to store the merged data
        df_merged <- NULL

        
        # Loop through each wave
        for (wave in allWaves) {
            # Read the RDS file for the current wave
            df_wavedat <- readRDS(paste0("temp_", wave, ".rds"))
            
            # Perform a left join with the merged_data dataframe
            if (is.null(df_merged)) {
            df_merged <- df_wavedat
            } else {
            df_merged <- merge(df_merged, df_wavedat, by = "pidp", all = TRUE)
            }
        }
        
        # Move pidp to the beginning of the file
        df_widedata <- df_merged[order(df_merged$pidp), ]
        # Merge wave-independent nurse/lab data AFTER combining waves
        # df_widedata <- merge(df_widedata, df_allnurse, by = "pidp", all = TRUE)
        df_wide <- df_widedata[order(df_widedata$pidp), ]

        # save the long file
        saveRDS(df_wide, file = paste0(outputpath, "/", outputfilename, ".rds"))
        # saveRDS(df_widedata, file = paste0(outputpath, "/", outputfilename, ".rds"))

        # Erase temporary files
            for (wave in allWaves) {
                file.remove(paste0("temp_", wave, ".rds"))
            }
```

```{r set up that works?}
rm(list = ls())

# ---- Settings -------------------------------------------------------------------------
setwd("C:/Users/Jamie/Documents/compass")

# Folder with the UKHLS .tab files (no trailing slash needed)
ukhls      <- "C:/Users/Jamie/Documents/compass/Input/Survey"
outputpath <- "C:/Users/Jamie/Documents/compass/data/England"
outputfilename <- "UKHLS_wide_j"

# Waves to extract (letters, separated by spaces). NB: the main pipeline uses wave "n".
allWaves <- "j"

# Variables to keep from each file (without wave prefix)
indallvars <- "age_dv chdisdifb1 chdisdifb10 chdisdifb11 chdisdifb12 chdisdifb2 chdisdifb3 chdisdifb4 chdisdifb5 chdisdifb6 chdisdifb7 chdisdifb8 chdisdifb9 chdisdifb96 chhealth2 country ethn_dv ff_ivlolw gor_dv hhsize hidp iviolw mastat_dv nchild_dv pidp pno psnen01_lw psnen01_xw psnen91_lw psnen91_xw psnen99_lw psnen99_xw psneng2_lw psneng2_xw psnenub_lw psnenub_xw psnenui_lw psnenui_xw psnenus_lw psnenus_xw psu racel_dv sex_dv strata urban_dv"

indvars <- "age_dv country disdif1 disdif10 disdif11 disdif12 disdif2 disdif3 disdif4 disdif5 disdif6 disdif7 disdif8 disdif9 disdif96 ethn_dv ff_emplw ff_ivlolw ffbrfedlw ftexw gor_dv health hhsize hhtype_dv hidp hldsbl1 ind5mus_lw ind5mus_xw indbd91_lw indbdub_lw indin01_lw indin01_xw indin91_lw indin91_xw indin99_lw indin99_xw inding2_lw inding2_xw indinub_lw indinub_xw indinui_lw indinui_xw indinus_lw indinus_xw indns91_lw indnsub_lw indpxg2_xw indpxub_lw indpxub_xw indpxui_lw indpxui_xw indpxus_lw indpxus_xw indscg2_xw indscub_lw indscub_xw indscui_lw indscui_xw indscus_lw indscus_xw iviolw jbstat mastat_dv nbornlw nchild_dv pidp pno psu racel_dv sex_dv strata tenure_dv ukborn urban_dv"

# cddis added so parent-reported child disability comes through alongside ypltdis
chvars <- "age_dv cddis chddvg2_xw chddvub_lw chddvub_xw chddvui_lw chddvui_xw country gor_dv hhsize hidp iviolw pidp pno psnen01_lw psnen91_lw psneng2_lw psneng2_xw psnenub_lw psnenub_xw psnenui_lw psnenui_xw psnenus_lw psnenus_xw psu send sex_dv strata urban_dv"

hhvars <- "country fihhmnnet1_dv gor_dv hhden01_xw hhden91_xw hhden99_xw hhdeng2_xw hhdenub_xw hhdenui_xw hhdenus_xw hhsize hhtype_dv hidp hsivlw ieqmoecd_dv nkids_dv psu strata tenure_dv urban_dv xpgaslw xpleclw"

youthvars <- "age_dv country ethn_dv gor_dv hidp pidp pno psu racel_dv sex_dv strata urban_dv ypltdis ypsmlw ypwklw ythscg2_xw ythscub_xw ythscui_xw ythscus_xw"

# ---- Packages ------------------------------------------------------------------------
for (p in c("readr", "dplyr")) {
  if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(p)
  library(p, character.only = TRUE)
}

# ---- Helpers -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Add the wave prefix to each variable, except pidp (which has no prefix)
getVars <- function(vars, wave) {
  v <- strsplit(vars, " ")[[1]]
  ifelse(v == "pidp", "pidp", paste0(wave, "_", v))
}

# Read one UKHLS file for a wave
readWave <- function(wave, file) {
  read_tsv(file.path(ukhls, paste0(wave, "_", file, ".tab")), show_col_types = FALSE)
}

# Drop columns already in `base` (except the merge keys) so merges don't create .x / .y suffixes
dropOverlap <- function(df, base, keys) {
  df[, !(names(df) %in% names(base)) | names(df) %in% keys, drop = FALSE]
}

# Debug: count of under-16s by age at each step
checkKids <- function(df, wave, label) {
  a <- df[[paste0(wave, "_age_dv")]]
  cat("\n", label, ": under-16s by age\n", sep = "")
  print(table(a[!is.na(a) & a >= 0 & a < 16]))
}

# ---- Extract each wave ---------------------------------------------------------------
allWaves <- strsplit(allWaves, " ")[[1]]

for (wave in allWaves) {
  hidp <- paste0(wave, "_hidp")
  keep <- unique(c("pidp", hidp,
                   getVars(hhvars, wave), getVars(indallvars, wave), getVars(indvars, wave),
                   getVars(chvars, wave), getVars(youthvars, wave)))

  # 1. Household file
  hh <- readWave(wave, "hhresp")
  hh <- hh[, intersect(c(hidp, getVars(hhvars, wave)), names(hh)), drop = FALSE]

  # 2. indall = spine of everyone in responding households
  indall <- readWave(wave, "indall")
  indall <- indall[, intersect(c("pidp", hidp, getVars(indallvars, wave)), names(indall)), drop = FALSE]
  indall <- dropOverlap(indall, hh, keys = hidp)          # household vars come from hhresp
  df <- left_join(indall, hh, by = hidp)
  df <- df[!is.na(df$pidp), ]
  checkKids(df, wave, "After indall + hhresp")

  # 3. indresp (adults with an interview)
  indresp <- readWave(wave, "indresp")
  indresp <- indresp[, intersect(c("pidp", getVars(indvars, wave)), names(indresp)), drop = FALSE]
  df <- left_join(df, dropOverlap(indresp, df, keys = "pidp"), by = "pidp")
  checkKids(df, wave, "After indresp")

  # 4. youth (10-15 self-completion)
  youth <- readWave(wave, "youth")
  youth <- youth[, intersect(c("pidp", getVars(youthvars, wave)), names(youth)), drop = FALSE]
  df <- left_join(df, dropOverlap(youth, df, keys = "pidp"), by = "pidp")
  checkKids(df, wave, "After youth")

  # 5. child (parent-reported, under 16)
  child <- readWave(wave, "child")
  child <- child[, intersect(c("pidp", getVars(chvars, wave)), names(child)), drop = FALSE]
  df <- left_join(df, dropOverlap(child, df, keys = "pidp"), by = "pidp")
  checkKids(df, wave, "After child")

  # Report any requested variables that weren't found in this wave
  missing_vars <- setdiff(keep, names(df))
  if (length(missing_vars)) cat("\nNot found in wave ", wave, ": ", paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")

  df <- df[, intersect(keep, names(df)), drop = FALSE]
  saveRDS(df, file = paste0("temp_", wave, ".rds"))
}

# ---- Combine waves (wide, one row per person) ---------------------------------------
df_merged <- NULL
for (wave in allWaves) {
  df_wave <- readRDS(paste0("temp_", wave, ".rds"))
  df_merged <- if (is.null(df_merged)) df_wave else full_join(df_merged, df_wave, by = "pidp")
}

df_wide <- df_merged[order(df_merged$pidp), c("pidp", setdiff(names(df_merged), "pidp"))]
saveRDS(df_wide, file = file.path(outputpath, paste0(outputfilename, ".rds")))

# Remove temporary files
file.remove(paste0("temp_", allWaves, ".rds"))

cat("\nSaved ", nrow(df_wide), " people to ", file.path(outputpath, paste0(outputfilename, ".rds")), "\n", sep = "")
```

```{r recode us_hh, echo=FALSE}
# Recode us_hh data, including disability
    ### Meta ###
        # Author: Andreas Hoehn & Hugh Rice & Ric Colasanti
        # Version: 0.9
        # Date:  2026-04-22
        # About: Re-Code the Understanding Society Survey. The steps for this are;
        # 1. Define Variables for Inclusion --> comes from different survey response files
        # 2. Link Response Files --> this is to ensure the full HH structure 
        # 3. Identify Kinship Structure --> identifying household heads and kinship in HH / save both as separate outputs
        # 4. Align Categories for Survey Constraint Variables --> match census tables
        # 5A. Assert No Missing Values in Constraints, Reduce, Save --> for creation
        # 5B. Imputation of Missing Information --> for validation, demo only

        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

### [1] Define Variables for Inclusion ###
l_definitions$recode_setup_survey <- TRUE
if (l_definitions$recode_setup_survey == TRUE) {
### rest:
        # initialise an object for variables to keep
            l_keep_vars   <- list() # for subsetting surveys
        # set missing l_definition
            l_definitions$us_wave <- "n"
        # ----- #
        
        # load indall: survey population spine --> starting point for anything
        dt_indall <- data.table::fread("Input/Survey/n_indall.tab")
        l_keep_vars[[1L]] <- c("pidp",
                            "hidp", 
                            "buno_dv",
                            "pno",
                            "sex",
                            "age_dv"
                            # "chhealth2" # all -8 (NA); using cddis later on from _child
                            ) 
                            
        dt_indall <- .RenamneFun(dt_in = dt_indall, wv = l_definitions$us_wave)
        dt_indall <- .SubsetFun(dt_in = dt_indall, l_sub = l_keep_vars, i = 1L)
            # debugging
                # list.files("Input/Survey")
        l_definitions$diag_surv_size_ind_load <- length(unique(dt_indall$pidp))

        # ----- #
        
        # load hhresp: hh-level responses
        dt_hhresp  <- data.table::fread("Input/Survey/n_hhresp.tab")
        l_keep_vars[[2L]] <- c("hidp",
                            "gor_dv",         # household identifier; Added n_ as well
                            "urban_dv",     # urban     
                            "hhtype_dv",    # household type
                            "tenure_dv",    # household tenure
                            "hhsize",       # HH size
                            "heatch",       # central heated yes/no
                            "ncars",        # Number of cars in the hh
                            "hsbeds",       # Number of bedrooms
                            "hsrooms",      # Number of other rooms (for habitable rooms number)
                            "hhdeng2_xw")   # Wave 14 Cross-Sectional Weight
        
                            # colnames(dt_hhresp)
                            # grep("n_urban", names(dt_hhresp), value = TRUE)
        
        dt_hhresp <- .RenamneFun(dt_in = dt_hhresp, wv = l_definitions$us_wave)
        dt_hhresp <- .SubsetFun(dt_in = dt_hhresp, l_sub = l_keep_vars, i = 2L)
        l_definitions$diag_surv_size_hh_load <- length(unique(dt_hhresp$hidp))

        # ----- # 
        
        # indresp: Adults, 16y+
        dt_indresp <- data.table::fread("Input/Survey/n_indresp.tab") # 16y+
        l_keep_vars[[3L]] <- c("pidp",
                            "marstat",
                            "hiqual_dv",
                            "ethn_dv",
                            "jbstat",
                            "jbft_dv",
                            "scsf1",
                            "health",
                            "aidhh",
                            "naidxhh",
                            paste0("disdif", 1:12), "disdif96")   
        dt_indresp <- .RenamneFun(dt_in = dt_indresp, wv = l_definitions$us_wave)
        dt_indresp <- .SubsetFun(dt_in = dt_indresp, l_sub = l_keep_vars, i = 3L)
        dt_indresp[, source_indresp := 1L] # for source of individual-level data 
           
        # child: all under 16y, parent/proxy respondent
        dt_child   <- data.table::fread("Input/Survey/n_child.tab")  
        l_keep_vars[[4L]] <- c("pidp", 
                                "cddis") # Longstanding health condition
                                # "chhealth2") 

        dt_child <- .RenamneFun(dt_in = dt_child, wv = l_definitions$us_wave)
        dt_child <- .SubsetFun(dt_in = dt_child, l_sub = l_keep_vars, i = 4L)
        dt_child[, source_child := 1L] # for source of individual-level data 

        # ----- # 
        
        # youth: additional questions for 10y-15y 
        dt_youth   <- data.table::fread("Input/Survey/n_youth.tab")  
        l_keep_vars[[5L]] <- c("pidp",
                                "ypltdis") # longstanding health conditioni 
        dt_youth <- .RenamneFun(dt_in = dt_youth, wv = l_definitions$us_wave)
        dt_youth <- .SubsetFun(dt_in = dt_youth, l_sub = l_keep_vars, i = 5L)
        dt_youth[, source_youth := 1L] # for source of individual-level data 


        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
    
### [2] Link Response Files ### 
        dt_survey <- merge(x = dt_hhresp, y = dt_indall,  by = "hidp", all.x = TRUE)
        dt_survey <- merge(x = dt_survey, y = dt_indresp, by = "pidp", all.x = TRUE)
        dt_survey <- merge(x = dt_survey, y = dt_child,   by = "pidp", all.x = TRUE)
        dt_survey <- merge(x = dt_survey, y = dt_youth,   by = "pidp", all.x = TRUE)
        
        # Replace NAs with 0
        for (v in c("source_indresp", "source_child", "source_youth"))
        set(dt_survey, which(is.na(dt_survey[[v]])), v, 0L)

        dt_survey <- merge(x = dt_hhresp, y = dt_indall,  by = "hidp", all.x = TRUE)
        dt_survey <- merge(x = dt_survey, y = dt_indresp, by = "pidp", all.x = TRUE)
        dt_survey <- merge(x = dt_survey, y = dt_child,   by = "pidp", all.x = TRUE)
        dt_survey <- merge(x = dt_survey, y = dt_youth,   by = "pidp", all.x = TRUE)

    # Create disability source variable
        # (unmatched rows from the all.x merges are NA, not 0, so set them to 0 first)
        for (v in c("source_indresp", "source_child", "source_youth"))
          set(dt_survey, which(is.na(dt_survey[[v]])), v, 0L)

        dt_survey[, source := "indall_only"]
        dt_survey[source_indresp == 1L,                         source := "indresp"]
        dt_survey[source_child   == 1L & source_youth == 1L,    source := "child_youth"]
        dt_survey[source_child   == 1L & source_youth == 0L,    source := "child_only"]
        dt_survey[source_child   == 0L & source_youth == 1L,    source := "youth_only"]
        dt_survey[, c("source_indresp", "source_child", "source_youth") := NULL]


    # Create disability variable (ind_disability)
        dt_survey[, ind_disability := NA_integer_]
        dt_survey[, dis_source := NA_character_]
        
        # For adults (ages 16+)
            # 1. health var
                # 'do you have any long-standing phys or mental impairment, illness, or disability?' 
                # -9 (missing), -2 (refusal), -1 (don't know), 1 (yes), 2 (no) (wild)
            # 2. disdif(1-12) vars
                # limitation in 11 activity types 
                # -9 (missing), -2 (refusal), -1 (don't know), 0 (not mentioned), 1 (mentioned)
                # disdif12 for 'other', so inclusive beyond the 11 options. 
            # 3. disdif96 var
                # 'none of these'
                # -9 (missing), -2 (refusal), -1 (don't know), 0 (not mentioned), 1 (mentioned)

            # Building it right (not using 'all NOT answering NONE')
                disdif_cols <- paste0("disdif", 1:12)
                # 1 if any difficulty is mentioned, 0 if none mentioned, negative = missing/don't know 
                # flagged as having a disability aliging with EADD (ind_disability == 1) if 'health' == 1 & 'disdif#'' == 1
                dt_survey[, any_difficulty := as.integer(rowSums(.SD == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0), .SDcols = disdif_cols]
                dt_survey[health == 1 & any_difficulty == 1, `:=`(ind_disability = 1L, dis_source = "health_disdif")] # responds yes to health condition and yes to limitations 
                dt_survey[health == 2 | (health == 1 & any_difficulty == 0), `:=`(ind_disability = 0L, dis_source = "health_disdif")] # responds no to health condition, or yes to health condition but no to limitations
        
        # For children (ages <16) 
            # 1. cddis var
                # 'question'
                # -9 (n=2), -8 (6923), -2 (7), -1 (1), 1 (261), 2 (1470) 
                # parent reports as proxy; asked at ages 3, 5, 8
            # Building it 
                dt_survey[is.na(ind_disability) & cddis == 1,  `:=`(ind_disability = 1L, dis_source = "cddis")]
                dt_survey[is.na(ind_disability) & cddis == 2,  `:=`(ind_disability = 0L, dis_source = "cddis")]

        # For youths (ages 10-16)
            # 1. ypltdis var
                # -9 (only 11), 1 (40), 2 (197), 3 (1304)
                # self-report; but used only where cddis is missing
            # Building it 
                dt_survey[is.na(ind_disability) & ypltdis %in% c(1, 2), `:=`(ind_disability = 1L, dis_source = "ypltdis")]
                dt_survey[is.na(ind_disability) & ypltdis == 3, `:=`(ind_disability = 0L, dis_source = "ypltdis")]

        # Imputation 
            .SurvDisability <- function(data_in, ctr_code,
                                        impute_children = TRUE,
                                        impute_adults   = TRUE,
                                        seed = 2026) {
            # start with deep copy
            data_out <- copy(data_in)
            data_out[, dis_imputed := 0L]
            # dis_imputed codes:
            #   0 = observed
            #   1 = child 3-15, imputed from observed rates
            #   2 = child 0-2, set to not disabled
            #   3 = adult 16+, imputed from observed rates

            # Children <16
                if (impute_children) {
                    data_out[, child_band := cut(age_dv, c(-1, 4, 9, 15), labels = c("0_4", "5_9", "10_15"))]

                    # observed rates among children who did answer, by sex and age band
                    # (computed before ages 0-2 are set, so those zeros don't affect them)
                    rates_child <- data_out[age_dv >= 0 & age_dv <= 15 & sex %in% c(1, 2) & !is.na(ind_disability),
                                            .(p = mean(ind_disability), n = .N), by = .(sex, child_band)]
                    cat("\nObserved child disability rates used for imputation:\n")
                    print(rates_child[order(sex, child_band)])

                    # ages 0-2: no disability question asked; treat as not disabled
                    n_infants <- data_out[age_dv >= 0 & age_dv <= 2 & is.na(ind_disability), .N]
                    data_out[age_dv >= 0 & age_dv <= 2 & is.na(ind_disability),
                            `:=`(ind_disability = 0L, dis_imputed = 2L)]

                    # ages 3-15 without a valid answer: impute from observed rates
                    need_child <- data_out[age_dv >= 3 & age_dv <= 15 & sex %in% c(1, 2) & is.na(ind_disability),
                                        .(pidp, sex, child_band)]
                    need_child <- merge(need_child, rates_child[, .(sex, child_band, p)],
                                        by = c("sex", "child_band"), all.x = TRUE)
                    if (anyNA(need_child$p)) stop("No observed disability rate for some sex/age groups of children")

                    set.seed(seed)
                    need_child[, imp := rbinom(.N, 1, p)]
                    data_out[need_child, on = "pidp", `:=`(ind_disability = i.imp, dis_imputed = 1L)]

                    cat("Set to not disabled (ages 0-2): ", n_infants, " children.\n", sep = "")
                    cat("Imputed from observed rates (ages 3-15): ", nrow(need_child), " children.\n", sep = "")
                }

            # Adults 16+
                if (impute_adults) {
                    data_out[, adult_band := cut(age_dv, c(15, 24, 34, 49, 64, Inf),
                                                labels = c("16_24", "25_34", "35_49", "50_64", "65p"))]

                    rates_adult <- data_out[age_dv >= 16 & sex %in% c(1, 2) & !is.na(ind_disability),
                                            .(p = mean(ind_disability), n = .N), by = .(sex, adult_band)]
                    cat("\nObserved adult disability rates used for imputation:\n")
                    print(rates_adult[order(sex, adult_band)])

                    need_adult <- data_out[age_dv >= 16 & sex %in% c(1, 2) & is.na(ind_disability),
                                        .(pidp, sex, adult_band)]
                    need_adult <- merge(need_adult, rates_adult[, .(sex, adult_band, p)],
                                        by = c("sex", "adult_band"), all.x = TRUE)
                    if (anyNA(need_adult$p)) stop("No observed disability rate for some sex/age groups of adults")

                    set.seed(seed + 1)
                    need_adult[, imp := rbinom(.N, 1, p)]
                    data_out[need_adult, on = "pidp", `:=`(ind_disability = i.imp, dis_imputed = 3L)]

                    cat("Imputed from observed rates (adults 16+): ", nrow(need_adult), " adults.\n", sep = "")
                }

            # imputation summary 
                cat("\nDisability by imputation status:\n")
                print(data_out[, .N, by = .(dis_imputed, ind_disability)][order(dis_imputed, ind_disability)])
                n_left <- data_out[is.na(ind_disability), .N]
                if (n_left > 0) cat("Still missing (e.g. invalid age or sex): ", n_left, "\n", sep = "")

            # reduce & return
                data_out <- copy(data_out[, .(hidp, pidp, new_var = ind_disability, imp_flag = dis_imputed)])
                setkey(data_out, hidp, pidp)
                data.table::setnames(data_out, old = c("new_var", "imp_flag"),
                                    new = paste0(ctr_code, c("_ind_disability", "_ind_disability_imputed")))
                return(data_out)
                }

### [3] Identify Kinship Structure ### 
        
        # identify the household heads #
        dt_survey[, hhref := 0L]

                        file = "Output/Survey/hh_all_refs.csv")

        # identify the number of people in each household

        # family relationship
        dt_egoalt   <- data.table::fread("Input/Survey/n_egoalt.tab")

            relationship_dv ==  9, kinship := "natural_parent"][
            relationship_dv == 10, kinship := "adoptive_parent"][
            relationship_dv == 11, kinship := "foster_parent"][

            relationship_dv == 22, kinship := "cousin"][
            relationship_dv == 23, kinship := "aunt_uncle"][
            relationship_dv == 24, kinship := "niece_nephew"][
            relationship_dv == 25, kinship := "other_relative"][
            relationship_dv == 26, kinship := "employee"][
            relationship_dv == 27, kinship := "employer"][
            relationship_dv == 28, kinship := "lodger_boarder_tenant"][
            relationship_dv == 29, kinship := "landlord_landlady"][
            relationship_dv == 30, kinship := "other_non_relative"]

        dt_egoalt <- copy(dt_egoalt[apno <= 5, .(hidp, pidp, apno, kinship)])
        data.table::setkey(dt_egoalt, hidp, pidp, apno)
        dt_egoalt[, status := paste0("kinship",seq_len(.N)), by = "pidp"]
        dt_egoalt <- data.table::dcast(dt_egoalt[, .(hidp, pidp, status, kinship)],
                                    hidp + pidp ~ status, value.var = "kinship")

        dt_survey <- merge(x = dt_survey, y = dt_egoalt,
                            by = c("hidp", "pidp"), all.x = TRUE)

        # key and setcolorder
        data.table::setcolorder(dt_survey,
                    c("hidp", "pno_max", "pno", "pidp", "buno_dv", "hhref", "source"))
        data.table::setkey(dt_survey, hidp, buno_dv, pno)

        # surv size after all merges 
        l_definitions$diag_surv_size_hh_merge <- length(unique(dt_survey$hidp))
        l_definitions$diag_surv_size_ind_merge <- length(unique(dt_survey$pidp))

### [4] Recode Key Variables Used for Constraints ###

        rm(dt_survey_EW)
        # c00 HH Region
            .SurvRegion <- function(data_in, ctr_code) {
            
            # start with deep copy
            data_out <- copy(data_in)
            
            # recoding
            data_out[,  gor_dv := as.character(gor_dv)]
            data_out[gor_dv %in% c(1:9), gor_dv := "england"]
            data_out[gor_dv %in% c(10:12), gor_dv := "other"]
            # reduce & return
            data_out <- copy(data_out[, .(hidp,pidp, new_var = gor_dv)])
            setkey(data_out, hidp, pidp)
            
            # tidy variable names
            data.table::setnames(data_out, old = "new_var",
                                new = paste0(ctr_code,"_hh_region"))
            
            # explicit return
            return(data_out)
            }

            # function call: EW
            dt_extracted <- .SurvRegion(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "EW")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

        # c01 HH Urban Rural Functional Form
            .SurvUrbanRural <- function(data_in, ctr_code) {
            
            # start with deep copy
            data_out <- copy(data_in)
            
            # recoding
            data_out[,  urban_dv := as.character(urban_dv)]
            data_out[urban_dv == "-9", urban_dv := as.character(NA)]
            data_out[urban_dv == "1", urban_dv := "urban"]
            data_out[urban_dv == "2", urban_dv := "rural"]
            
            # reduce & return
            data_out <- copy(data_out[, .(hidp,pidp, new_var = urban_dv)])
            setkey(data_out, hidp, pidp)
            
            # tidy variable names
            data.table::setnames(data_out, old = "new_var",
                                new = paste0(ctr_code,"_hh_urban_rural"))
            
            # explicit return
            return(data_out)
            }

            # function call: SCOTLAND
            dt_extracted <- .SurvUrbanRural(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "SCO")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

            # function call: EW
            dt_extracted <- .SurvUrbanRural(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "EW")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

            # function call: NI
            dt_extracted <- .SurvUrbanRural(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "NI")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

        # c02 HH Heating Functional Form 
            .SurvHeating <- function(data_in, ctr_code) {
            
            # start with deep copy
            data_out <- copy(data_in)
            
            # recoding 
            data_out[, heatch := as.character(heatch)]
            data_out[heatch %in% c("-2", "-1"), heatch := as.character(NA)]

            # reduce & return

            # tidy variable names

            # explicit return

            # function call: SCOTLAND

            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

            # function call: EW
            dt_extracted <- .SurvHeating(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "EW")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

            # function call: NI

        # c03 HH Type Functional Form 
            .SurvHHType <- function(data_in, ctr_code) {
            
            # start with deep copy
            data_out <- copy(data_in)
            
            # SCOTLAND # 
            if (ctr_code == "SCO") {
                data_out[, hhtype_dv := as.character(hhtype_dv)]
                data_out[hhtype_dv %in% c("1", "2"),hhtype_dv := "one_person_pensionable_no_children"]                              # any one person HH >= 66M/60F, no children: D4 ! we assign women 60-65 to be 66+ !
                data_out[hhtype_dv %in% c("3"),   hhtype_dv := "one_person_not_pensionable_no_children"]                            # any one person HH younger, no children: E4
                data_out[hhtype_dv %in% c("4"), hhtype_dv := "lone_parent_one_child"]                                               # lone parent household, 1 child: S4
                data_out[hhtype_dv %in% c("5"), hhtype_dv := "lone_parent_two_or_more_children"]                                    # lone parent household, 2+ children: T4/U4
                data_out[hhtype_dv %in% c("6", "8", "19"), hhtype_dv := "couple_married_civil_no_children"]                         # married/civil/couple, no children, incl. others: I4/N4
                data_out[hhtype_dv %in% c("10", "11", "12", "20", "21"), hhtype_dv := "couple_married_civil_one_or_more_children"]  # married/civil/couple, 1+ children: J4/O4
                data_out[hhtype_dv %in% c("16", "17", "18", "22", "23"), hhtype_dv := "hh_type_other"]    
            }
            # ENGLAND WALES
            if (ctr_code == "EW" | ctr_code == "NI") {
            data_out[, hhtype_dv := as.character(hhtype_dv)]
            data_out[hhtype_dv %in% c("1", "2", "3"),hhtype_dv := "one_person_household"]          
            data_out[hhtype_dv %in% c("4","5"), hhtype_dv := "lone_parent"]                                                # lone parent household with/without dependent children
            data_out[hhtype_dv %in% c("6", "8", "19"), hhtype_dv := "couple_married_civil_no_children"]                    # married/civil/couple, no children, incl. others: I4/N4
            data_out[hhtype_dv %in% c("10", "11", "12", "20", "21"), hhtype_dv := "couple_married_civil_with_children"]    # married/civil/couple, 1+ children: J4/O4
            data_out[hhtype_dv %in% c("16", "17", "18", "22", "23"), hhtype_dv := "other"]                                 # other                              # V4 onwards 
            }
            
            # reduce & return
            data_out <- copy(data_out[, .(hidp,pidp, new_var = hhtype_dv)])
            setkey(data_out, hidp, pidp)
            
            # tidy variable names
            data.table::setnames(data_out, old = "new_var",
                                new = paste0(ctr_code,"_hh_type"))

            # explicit return
            return(data_out)
            } 
            
            # function call: SCOTLAND
            dt_extracted <- .SurvHHType(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "SCO")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

            # function call: EW
            dt_extracted <- .SurvHHType(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "EW")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

            # function call: NI
            dt_extracted <- .SurvHHType(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "NI")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

            # ----- # 

        # c04 HH tenure X age of youngest child #

            .SurvHHTenureChild <- function(data_in, ctr_code) {
            
            # start with deep copy
            data_out <- copy(data_in)
            
            # GENERAL RECODING
            data_out[,  tenure_dv := as.character(tenure_dv)]
            data_out[tenure_dv == "1",  tenure_dv := "owned_outright"]
            data_out[tenure_dv == "2",  tenure_dv := "owned_mortgage"]
            data_out[tenure_dv == "3",  tenure_dv := "social_rented"]
            data_out[tenure_dv == "4",  tenure_dv := "social_rented"]
            data_out[tenure_dv == "5",  tenure_dv := "private_rented"]
            data_out[tenure_dv == "6",  tenure_dv := "private_rented"]
            data_out[tenure_dv == "7",  tenure_dv := "private_rented"]
            data_out[tenure_dv == "8",  tenure_dv := "private_rented"]
            data_out[tenure_dv == "-9", tenure_dv := as.character(NA)]
            
            # add dependent children flag
            data_out[, dependent_child := 0]              # initialize ... then SG definition
            data_out[age_dv <= 15, dependent_child := 1]  # any person younger than 15
            data_out[                                     # OR 16-18 and in FT education
                (age_dv >= 16 & age_dv <= 18) &             #    and not married/partner/cohabited
                (jbstat %in% c(7, 9, 11)) & 
                ((kinship1 %in% c("natural_son_daughter", "adopted_son_daughter",
                                    "foster_child", "stepson_stepdaughter", "grand_child")) |
                    (kinship2 %in% c("natural_son_daughter", "adopted_son_daughter",
                                    "foster_child", "stepson_stepdaughter", "grand_child")) |
                    (kinship3 %in% c("natural_son_daughter", "adopted_son_daughter",
                                    "foster_child", "stepson_stepdaughter", "grand_child")) |
                    (kinship4 %in% c("natural_son_daughter", "adopted_son_daughter",
                                    "foster_child", "stepson_stepdaughter", "grand_child"))|
                    (kinship5 %in% c("natural_son_daughter", "adopted_son_daughter",
                                    "foster_child", "stepson_stepdaughter", "grand_child"))) & 
                (!(kinship1 %in% c("husband_wife", "partner_cohabitee", "civil_partner")) |
                    !(kinship2 %in% c("husband_wife", "partner_cohabitee", "civil_partner")) |
                    !(kinship1 %in% c("husband_wife", "partner_cohabitee", "civil_partner")) |
                    !(kinship1 %in% c("husband_wife", "partner_cohabitee", "civil_partner")) |
                    !(kinship1 %in% c("husband_wife", "partner_cohabitee", "civil_partner"))),
                dependent_child := 1]
            data_out[, dependent_child_count := sum(dependent_child), by = c("hidp")]
            
            # add youngest dependent children age
            data_out[dependent_child == 1, min_age := min(age_dv), by = c("hidp")]
            data_out[, youngest_child := as.integer(NA)]
            data_out[dependent_child == 1 & age_dv == min_age, youngest_child := age_dv]
            data_out[, youngest_child := min(youngest_child, na.rm = TRUE), by = c("hidp")]
            setkey(data_out, hidp, pno)
            
            # SCOTLAND # 
            if (ctr_code == "SCO") {

                # combine
                data_out[tenure_dv == "owned_outright" & is.na(youngest_child), tenure_dv := "owned_outright_no_children"]
                data_out[tenure_dv == "owned_mortgage" & is.na(youngest_child), tenure_dv := "owned_mortgage_no_children"]
                data_out[tenure_dv == "social_rented"  & is.na(youngest_child), tenure_dv := "social_rented_no_children"]
                data_out[tenure_dv == "private_rented" & is.na(youngest_child), tenure_dv := "private_rented_no_children"]
                
                data_out[tenure_dv == "owned_outright" & youngest_child <= 4, tenure_dv := "owned_outright_00_04"]
                data_out[tenure_dv == "owned_mortgage" & youngest_child <= 4, tenure_dv := "owned_mortgage_00_04"]
                data_out[tenure_dv == "social_rented"  & youngest_child <= 4, tenure_dv := "social_rented_00_04"]
                data_out[tenure_dv == "private_rented" & youngest_child <= 4, tenure_dv := "private_rented_00_04"]
                
                data_out[tenure_dv == "owned_outright" & youngest_child >= 5 & youngest_child <= 11, tenure_dv := "owned_outright_05_11"]
                data_out[tenure_dv == "owned_mortgage" & youngest_child >= 5 & youngest_child <= 11, tenure_dv := "owned_mortgage_05_11"]
                data_out[tenure_dv == "social_rented"  & youngest_child >= 5 & youngest_child <= 11, tenure_dv := "social_rented_05_11"]
                data_out[tenure_dv == "private_rented" & youngest_child >= 5 & youngest_child <= 11, tenure_dv := "private_rented_05_11"]
                
                data_out[tenure_dv == "owned_outright" & youngest_child >= 12 & youngest_child <= 18, tenure_dv := "owned_outright_12_18"]
                data_out[tenure_dv == "owned_mortgage" & youngest_child >= 12 & youngest_child <= 18, tenure_dv := "owned_mortgage_12_18"]
                data_out[tenure_dv == "social_rented"  & youngest_child >= 12 & youngest_child <= 18, tenure_dv := "social_rented_12_18"]
                data_out[tenure_dv == "private_rented" & youngest_child >= 12 & youngest_child <= 18, tenure_dv := "private_rented_12_18"]
            }
            
            # ENGLAND WALES
            if (ctr_code == "EW") {

                # combine
                data_out[tenure_dv == "owned_outright" & is.na(youngest_child), tenure_dv := "owned_outright_no_children"]
                data_out[tenure_dv == "owned_mortgage" & is.na(youngest_child), tenure_dv := "owned_mortgage_no_children"]
                data_out[tenure_dv == "social_rented"  & is.na(youngest_child), tenure_dv := "social_rented_no_children"]
                data_out[tenure_dv == "private_rented" & is.na(youngest_child), tenure_dv := "private_rented_no_children"]
                
                data_out[tenure_dv == "owned_outright" & youngest_child <= 18, tenure_dv := "owned_outright_with_children"]
                data_out[tenure_dv == "owned_mortgage" & youngest_child <= 18, tenure_dv := "owned_mortgage_with_children"]
                data_out[tenure_dv == "social_rented"  & youngest_child <= 18, tenure_dv := "social_rented_with_children"]
                data_out[tenure_dv == "private_rented" & youngest_child <= 18, tenure_dv := "private_rented_with_children"]
            }
            
            # reduce & return
            data_out <- copy(data_out[, .(hidp,pidp, new_var = tenure_dv)])
            setkey(data_out, hidp, pidp)
            
            # tidy variable names
            if (ctr_code == "SCO"){
            data.table::setnames(data_out, old = "new_var",
                                new = paste0(ctr_code,"_hh_tenure_youngest_child"))
            }
            
            if (ctr_code == "EW") {
                data.table::setnames(data_out, old = "new_var",
                                    new = paste0(ctr_code,"_hh_tenure_presence_child"))
            }
            
            if (ctr_code == "NI") {
                data.table::setnames(data_out, old = "new_var",
                                    new = paste0(ctr_code,"_hh_tenure"))
            }
            
            # explicit return
            return(data_out)
            } 

            # function call: SCOTLAND
            dt_extracted <- .SurvHHTenureChild(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "SCO")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

            # function call: EW
            dt_extracted <- .SurvHHTenureChild(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "EW")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

            # function call: NI
            dt_extracted <- .SurvHHTenureChild(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "NI")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

        # c04b HH age of youngest child - NI only #

            .SurvHHChildNI <- function(data_in, ctr_code) {
            
            # start with deep copy
            data_out <- copy(data_in)
            
            # add dependent children flag
            data_out[, dependent_child := 0]              # initialize ... then SG definition
            data_out[age_dv <= 15, dependent_child := 1]  # any person younger than 15
            data_out[                                     # OR 16-18 and in FT education
                (age_dv >= 16 & age_dv <= 18) &             #    and not married/partner/cohabited
                (jbstat %in% c(7, 9, 11)) & 
                ((kinship1 %in% c("natural_son_daughter", "adopted_son_daughter",
                                    "foster_child", "stepson_stepdaughter", "grand_child")) |
                    (kinship2 %in% c("natural_son_daughter", "adopted_son_daughter",
                                    "foster_child", "stepson_stepdaughter", "grand_child")) |
                    (kinship3 %in% c("natural_son_daughter", "adopted_son_daughter",
                                    "foster_child", "stepson_stepdaughter", "grand_child")) |
                    (kinship4 %in% c("natural_son_daughter", "adopted_son_daughter",
                                    "foster_child", "stepson_stepdaughter", "grand_child"))|
                    (kinship5 %in% c("natural_son_daughter", "adopted_son_daughter",
                                    "foster_child", "stepson_stepdaughter", "grand_child"))) & 
                (!(kinship1 %in% c("husband_wife", "partner_cohabitee", "civil_partner")) |
                    !(kinship2 %in% c("husband_wife", "partner_cohabitee", "civil_partner")) |
                    !(kinship1 %in% c("husband_wife", "partner_cohabitee", "civil_partner")) |
                    !(kinship1 %in% c("husband_wife", "partner_cohabitee", "civil_partner")) |
                    !(kinship1 %in% c("husband_wife", "partner_cohabitee", "civil_partner"))),
                dependent_child := 1]
            data_out[, dependent_child_count := sum(dependent_child), by = c("hidp")]
            
            # add youngest dependent children age
            data_out[dependent_child == 1, min_age := min(age_dv), by = c("hidp")]
            data_out[, youngest_child := as.integer(NA)]
            data_out[dependent_child == 1 & age_dv == min_age, youngest_child := age_dv]
            data_out[, youngest_child := min(youngest_child, na.rm = TRUE), by = c("hidp")]
            setkey(data_out, hidp, pno)
            
            # combine
            data_out[, hh_youngest_child := as.character(NA)]
            data_out[dependent_child_count == 0, hh_youngest_child := "no_child"]
            data_out[youngest_child <= 4, hh_youngest_child := "youngest_child_00_04"]
            data_out[youngest_child >= 5 & youngest_child <= 11, hh_youngest_child := "youngest_child_05_11"]
            data_out[youngest_child >= 12 & youngest_child <= 18, hh_youngest_child := "youngest_child_12_18"]
            
            # reduce & return
            data_out <- copy(data_out[, .(hidp,pidp, new_var = hh_youngest_child)])
            setkey(data_out, hidp, pidp)
            
            data.table::setnames(data_out, old = "new_var",
                                    new = paste0(ctr_code,"_hh_youngest_child"))

                # explicit return
            return(data_out)
            } 

            # function call: NI Only 
            dt_extracted <- .SurvHHChildNI(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "NI")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

        # c05 HH cars + HH size #

            .SurvHHCarsSize <- function(data_in, ctr_code) {
            
            # start with deep copy
            data_out <- copy(data_in)
            
            # capping HH Size #
            data_out[hhsize >= 4, hhsize := 4] 
            data_out[, hhsize := paste0("hh_size_0",hhsize)]
            data_out[hhsize == "hh_size_04", hhsize := "hh_size_04p"]
            
            
            # SCOTLAND
            if (ctr_code == "SCO") {
            
                # capping number of cars
                data_out[ncars >= 4, ncars := 4]   # 4 or more cars 
                data_out[ncars %in% c(-2, -1), ncars := NA]
                data_out[, ncars := paste0("hh_cars_0",as.character(ncars))]
                data_out[ncars == "hh_cars_0NA", ncars := NA]
                data_out[ncars == "hh_cars_04" , ncars := "hh_cars_04p"]
                
                # hh cars by size
                data_out[, hh_ncars_hh_size := as.character(NA)]
                data_out[!is.na(ncars) & !is.na(hhsize),
                        hh_ncars_hh_size := paste0(ncars,"_",hhsize)]
            }
            
            # ENGLAND WALES
            if (ctr_code == "EW" | ctr_code == "NI") {
                
                # capping number of cars
                data_out[ncars >= 2, ncars := 2]   # 2 or more cars 
                data_out[ncars %in% c(-2, -1), ncars := NA]
                data_out[, ncars := paste0("hh_cars_0",as.character(ncars))]
                data_out[ncars == "hh_cars_0NA", ncars := NA]
                data_out[ncars == "hh_cars_02" , ncars := "hh_cars_02p"]
                
                
                # hh cars by size
                data_out[, hh_ncars_hh_size := as.character(NA)]
                data_out[!is.na(ncars) & !is.na(hhsize),
                        hh_ncars_hh_size := paste0(ncars,"_",hhsize)]
            }
            
            # reduce & return
            data_out <- copy(data_out[, .(hidp,pidp, new_var = hh_ncars_hh_size)])
            setkey(data_out, hidp, pidp)
            
            # tidy variable names
            data.table::setnames(data_out, old = "new_var",
                                new = paste0(ctr_code,"_hh_cars_hh_size"))
            
            # explicit return
            return(data_out)
            } 

            # function call: SCOTLAND
            dt_extracted <- .SurvHHCarsSize(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "SCO")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

            # function call: EW
            dt_extracted <- .SurvHHCarsSize(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "EW")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

            # function call: NI
            dt_extracted <- .SurvHHCarsSize(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "NI")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

            # ----- # 

        # c06 HH bedrooms + HH size #
            .SurvHHBedsSize <- function(data_in, ctr_code) {
            
            # start with deep copy
            data_out <- copy(data_in)
            
            # capping HH Size #
            data_out[hhsize >= 4, hhsize := 4] 
            data_out[, hhsize := paste0("hh_size_0",hhsize)]
            data_out[hhsize == "hh_size_04", hhsize := "hh_size_04p"]
            
            # GENERAL RECODING
            if (ctr_code == "SCO") {
                data_out[hsbeds >= 5, hsbeds := 5]   # 5 or more open ended 
                data_out[,  hsbeds := as.character(hsbeds)]
                data_out[hsbeds %in% c("-2", "-1"), hsbeds := as.character(NA)] # missing
                data_out[hsbeds %in% c("0", "1"),   hsbeds := "1"] # 1 bed
                data_out[hsbeds == "2", hsbeds := "2"]             # 2 beds
                data_out[hsbeds == "3", hsbeds := "3"]             # 3 beds
                data_out[hsbeds == "4", hsbeds := "4"]             # 4 beds
                data_out[hsbeds == "5", hsbeds := "5p"]            # 5p beds
                data_out[, hsbeds := paste0("hh_beds_0",hsbeds)]
                data_out[hsbeds == "hh_beds_0NA", hsbeds := NA]
            }
            
            if (ctr_code == "EW") {
                data_out[hsbeds >= 4, hsbeds := 4]   # 4 or more open ended 
                data_out[,  hsbeds := as.character(hsbeds)]
                data_out[hsbeds %in% c("-2", "-1"), hsbeds := as.character(NA)] # missing
                data_out[hsbeds %in% c("0", "1"),   hsbeds := "1"] # 1 bed
                data_out[hsbeds == "2", hsbeds := "2"]             # 2 beds
                data_out[hsbeds == "3", hsbeds := "3"]             # 3 beds
                data_out[hsbeds == "4", hsbeds := "4p"]            # 4p beds
                data_out[, hsbeds := paste0("hh_beds_0",hsbeds)]
                data_out[hsbeds == "hh_beds_0NA", hsbeds := NA]
            }
            
            if (ctr_code == "NI") {
                # recode inputs - habitable rooms = bedrooms + other rooms (excl kitchen/bath)
                data_out[hsbeds  <= -1, hsbeds  := as.integer(NA)]
                data_out[hsrooms <= -1, hsrooms := as.integer(NA)]
                # initialise / create habitable rooms 
                data_out[, hh_hrooms := as.integer(NA)]
                data_out[, hh_hrooms := hsbeds + hsrooms]  
                data_out[hh_hrooms >= 8, hh_hrooms := 8]   # 8 or more habitable rooms
                data_out[, hh_hrooms := paste0("hh_hrooms_0",hh_hrooms)]
                data_out[hh_hrooms %in% c("hh_hrooms_01", "hh_hrooms_02", "hh_hrooms_03"),
                        hh_hrooms := "hh_hrooms_01_02_03"]   # 8 or more habitable rooms
                data_out[hh_hrooms == "hh_hrooms_08", hh_hrooms := "hh_hrooms_08p"]   # 8 or more habitable rooms
                data_out[hh_hrooms == "hh_hrooms_0NA", hh_hrooms := NA]
            }
            
            if (ctr_code == "SCO" | ctr_code == "EW") {
                # hh beds by hh size
                data_out[!is.na(hsbeds) & !is.na(hhsize),
                        hh_nbeds_hh_size := paste0(hsbeds,"_",hhsize)]
                
                # reduce & return
                data_out <- copy(data_out[, .(hidp,pidp, new_var = hh_nbeds_hh_size)])
                setkey(data_out, hidp, pidp)
                
                # tidy variable names
                data.table::setnames(data_out, old = "new_var",
                                    new = paste0(ctr_code,"_hh_beds_hh_size"))
            }
            
            if (ctr_code == "NI") {
                # reduce & return
                data_out <- copy(data_out[, .(hidp,pidp, new_var = hh_hrooms)])
                setkey(data_out, hidp, pidp)
                
                # tidy variable names
                data.table::setnames(data_out, old = "new_var",
                                    new = paste0(ctr_code,"_hh_hrooms"))
            }
            
            # explicit return
            return(data_out)
            } 

            # function call: SCOTLAND
            dt_extracted <- .SurvHHBedsSize(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "SCO")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

            # function call: EW
            dt_extracted <- .SurvHHBedsSize(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "EW")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

            # # function call: NI 
            dt_extracted <- .SurvHHBedsSize(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "NI")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

            # ----- # 

        # c07 HH Activity X Size - Counts Cat
            .SurvActivitySize <- function(data_in, ctr_code) {
            
            # start with deep copy
            data_out <- copy(data_in)
            
            # capping HH Size #
            data_out[hhsize >= 4, hhsize := 4] 
            data_out[, hhsize := paste0("hh_size_0",hhsize)]
            data_out[hhsize == "hh_size_04", hhsize := "hh_size_04p"]
            
            # general recoding
            data_out[,  jbstat := as.character(jbstat)]
            data_out[jbstat %in% c("-1", "-2"), jbstat := NA]
            data_out[jbstat == "1",  jbstat := "self_employed"]
            data_out[jbstat %in% c("2", "5", "14", "15"),  jbstat := "employed"]
            data_out[jbstat == "3",  jbstat := "unemployed"]
            data_out[jbstat == "4",  jbstat := "retired"]
            data_out[jbstat == "6",  jbstat := "looking_after_home"]
            data_out[jbstat == "7",  jbstat := "student_ft"]
            data_out[jbstat == "8",  jbstat := "lts_disabled"]
            data_out[jbstat %in% c("9", "10", "11", "12", "13", "97"),  jbstat := "activity_other"]
            data_out[age_dv <= 15, jbstat := "activity_not_applicable"]
            
            # GENERAL RECODING
            data_out[, employment := 0L]
            data_out[, employment_count := 0L]
            data_out[jbstat %in% c("employed", "employed"), employment := 1L]
            data_out[, employment_count := sum(employment), by = "hidp"]
            data_out[employment_count >= 3,  employment_count := 3]
            data_out[,  employment_count := as.character(employment_count)]
            data_out[employment_count == "3",  employment_count := "3p"]
            
            data_out[, hh_nemployment_size := as.character(NA)]
            data_out[, hh_nemployment_size := paste0("hh_employed_0",employment_count,"_",hhsize)]
            
            # reduce & return
            data_out <- copy(data_out[, .(hidp,pidp, new_var = hh_nemployment_size)])
            setkey(data_out, hidp, pidp)
            
            # tidy variable names
            data.table::setnames(data_out, old = "new_var",
                                new = paste0(ctr_code,"_hh_employment_hh_size"))
            
            # explicit return
            return(data_out)
            } 

            # function call: SCOTLAND
            dt_extracted <- .SurvActivitySize(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "SCO")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

            # function call: EW
            dt_extracted <- .SurvActivitySize(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "EW")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

            # function call: EW
            dt_extracted <- .SurvActivitySize(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "NI")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))
            
            # ----- # 

    ## [4.2] Recode for Individual Level # 
        # c08 Ind Unpaid Carer
            .SurvCarerSize <- function(data_in, ctr_code) {
            
            # start with deep copy
            data_out <- copy(data_in)
            
            # capping HH Size #
            data_out[hhsize >= 4, hhsize := 4] 
            data_out[, hhsize := paste0("hh_size_0",hhsize)]
            
            # GENERAL RECODING: carer
            data_out[, carer    := as.character(NA)]
            data_out[aidhh == 1 | naidxhh >= 1, carer :=  "carer_yes"]
            data_out[(aidhh == 2 | aidhh == -8) & naidxhh <= 0, carer :=  "carer_no"]
            data_out[age_dv <= 15, carer := "carer_not_applicable"]

            # count carer
            data_out[, hh_ncarer_size  := as.integer(0L)]
            data_out[, carer_flag := as.integer(0L)]
            data_out[carer == "carer_yes", carer_flag := as.integer(1)]
            data_out[, hh_ncarer_size := sum(carer_flag), by = "hidp"]
            data_out[hh_ncarer_size >= 2, hh_ncarer_size := 2] 
            data_out[, hh_ncarer_size := paste0("hh_carer_0",hh_ncarer_size)]
            
            # SCOTLAND
            if (ctr_code == "SCO") {
                data_out[hh_ncarer_size == "hh_carer_00" & (hhsize ==  "hh_size_01" | hhsize ==  "hh_size_02"),
                        hh_ncarer_size := "hh_carer_00_hh_size_01_02"]
                data_out[hh_ncarer_size == "hh_carer_00" & (hhsize ==  "hh_size_03" | hhsize ==  "hh_size_04"),
                        hh_ncarer_size := "hh_carer_00_hh_size_03p"]
                data_out[hh_ncarer_size == "hh_carer_01" & (hhsize ==  "hh_size_01" | hhsize ==  "hh_size_02"),
                        hh_ncarer_size := "hh_carer_01_hh_size_01_02"]
                data_out[hh_ncarer_size == "hh_carer_01" & (hhsize ==  "hh_size_03" | hhsize ==  "hh_size_04"),
                        hh_ncarer_size := "hh_carer_01_hh_size_03p"]
                data_out[hh_ncarer_size == "hh_carer_02" & (hhsize ==  "hh_size_01" | hhsize ==  "hh_size_02"),
                        hh_ncarer_size := "hh_carer_02p_hh_size_01_02"]
                data_out[hh_ncarer_size == "hh_carer_02" & (hhsize ==  "hh_size_03" | hhsize ==  "hh_size_04"),
                        hh_ncarer_size := "hh_carer_02p_hh_size_03p"]
            }
            
            # NI
            if (ctr_code == "NI") {
                data_out[hh_ncarer_size == "hh_carer_00" & (hhsize ==  "hh_size_01"),
                        hh_ncarer_size := "hh_carer_00_hh_size_01"]
                data_out[hh_ncarer_size == "hh_carer_00" & (hhsize ==  "hh_size_02"),
                        hh_ncarer_size := "hh_carer_00_hh_size_02"]
                data_out[hh_ncarer_size == "hh_carer_00" & (hhsize ==  "hh_size_03" | hhsize ==  "hh_size_04"),
                        hh_ncarer_size := "hh_carer_00_hh_size_03p"]
                data_out[hh_ncarer_size == "hh_carer_01" & (hhsize ==  "hh_size_01"),
                        hh_ncarer_size := "hh_carer_01_hh_size_01"]
                data_out[hh_ncarer_size == "hh_carer_01" & (hhsize ==  "hh_size_02"),
                        hh_ncarer_size := "hh_carer_01_hh_size_02"]
                data_out[hh_ncarer_size == "hh_carer_01" & (hhsize ==  "hh_size_03" | hhsize ==  "hh_size_04"),
                        hh_ncarer_size := "hh_carer_01_hh_size_03p"]
                data_out[hh_ncarer_size == "hh_carer_02" & (hhsize ==  "hh_size_01" | hhsize ==  "hh_size_02"),
                        hh_ncarer_size := "hh_carer_02p_hh_size_02"]
                data_out[hh_ncarer_size == "hh_carer_02" & (hhsize ==  "hh_size_03" | hhsize ==  "hh_size_04"),
                        hh_ncarer_size := "hh_carer_02p_hh_size_03p"]
            }

        # c09 Ind Sex X Age # 1 = male / 2 = female 
            .SurvSexAge <- function(data_in, ctr_code) {
            
            # start with deep copy
            data_out <- copy(data_in)
            
            # General Recoding
            data_out[, sex_age := as.character(NA)]

            data_out[sex == 2 & age_dv <= 15, sex_age := "f_00_15"]
            data_out[sex == 2 & (age_dv >= 16 & age_dv <= 24), sex_age := "f_16_24"]   
            data_out[sex == 2 & (age_dv >= 25 & age_dv <= 34), sex_age := "f_25_34"]      
            data_out[sex == 2 & (age_dv >= 35 & age_dv <= 49), sex_age := "f_35_49"]      
            data_out[sex == 2 & (age_dv >= 50 & age_dv <= 64), sex_age := "f_50_64"]      
            data_out[sex == 2 & (age_dv >= 65), sex_age := "f_65p"]      

            data_out[sex == 1 & age_dv <= 15, sex_age := "m_00_15"]
            data_out[sex == 1 & (age_dv >= 16 & age_dv <= 24), sex_age := "m_16_24"]   
            data_out[sex == 1 & (age_dv >= 25 & age_dv <= 34), sex_age := "m_25_34"]      
            data_out[sex == 1 & (age_dv >= 35 & age_dv <= 49), sex_age := "m_35_49"]      
            data_out[sex == 1 & (age_dv >= 50 & age_dv <= 64), sex_age := "m_50_64"]      
            data_out[sex == 1 & (age_dv >= 65), sex_age := "m_65p"]      

            # reduce & return
            data_out <- copy(data_out[, .(hidp,pidp, new_var = sex_age)])
            setkey(data_out, hidp, pidp)

            # tidy variable names
            data.table::setnames(data_out, old = "new_var",
                                new = paste0(ctr_code,"_ind_sex_age"))

            # explicit return
            return(data_out)
            } 

            # function call: SCOTLAND

            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

        # c11 Ind Ethnicity #
            .SurvEth <- function(data_in, ctr_code) {
            
            # start with deep copy
            data_out <- copy(data_in)
            
            # General Recoding
            data_out[, ethn_dv := as.character(ethn_dv)]
            data_out[ethn_dv %in% c("-9"), ethn_dv := NA]
            data_out[ethn_dv %in% c("1","2","3","4"), ethn_dv := "white"]
            data_out[ethn_dv %in% c("5","6","7","8"), ethn_dv := "mixed"]
            data_out[ethn_dv %in% c("9","10","11","12","13"), ethn_dv := "asian"]
            data_out[ethn_dv %in% c("14"), ethn_dv := "caribbean_black"]
            data_out[ethn_dv %in% c("15","16"), ethn_dv := "african"]
            data_out[ethn_dv %in% c("17","97"), ethn_dv := "ethnicity_other"]
            
            # recode ethnicity for children based on HH ref where mising
            data_out[, ethn_dv_ref := as.character(NA)]
            data_out[hhref == 1, ethn_dv_ref := ethn_dv]
            data_out[, ethn_dv_ref := zoo::na.locf(ethn_dv_ref, na.rm = FALSE), by = c("hidp")]
            data_out[is.na(ethn_dv) & age_dv <= 15, ethn_dv := ethn_dv_ref]
            data_out[, ethn_dv_ref := NULL]
            
            # reduce & return
            data_out <- copy(data_out[, .(hidp, pidp, new_var = ethn_dv)])
            setkey(data_out, hidp, pidp)
            
            # tidy variable names
            data.table::setnames(data_out, old = "new_var",
                                new = paste0(ctr_code,"_ind_ethnicity"))
            
            # explicit return
            return(data_out)
            } 

            # function call: SCOTLAND
            dt_extracted <- .SurvEth(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "SCO")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

            # function call: EW
            dt_extracted <- .SurvEth(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "EW")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

            # function call: NI
            dt_extracted <- .SurvEth(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "NI")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

        # c13 Ind Health #
            .SurvHealth <- function(data_in, ctr_code) {
            
            # start with deep copy
            data_out <- copy(data_in)
            
            # General Recoding
            data_out[, scsf1 := as.character(scsf1)]

            data_out[scsf1 %in% c("1","2"), scsf1 := "very_good"]
            data_out[scsf1 %in% c("3"), scsf1 := "good"]
            data_out[scsf1 %in% c("4"), scsf1 := "fair"]

            setkey(data_out, hidp, pidp)

                                new = paste0(ctr_code,"_ind_health"))
            
            # explicit return
            return(data_out)
            } 

            # function call: SCOTLAND
            dt_extracted <- .SurvHealth(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "SCO")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

            # function call: EW
            dt_extracted <- .SurvHealth(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "EW")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

            # function call: NI
            dt_extracted <- .SurvHealth(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "NI")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

        # c13.1 Ind Disability
            #   children 0-2: set to not disabled (question not asked)
            #   children 3-15 and adults 16+ without a valid answer: imputed from observed rates by sex and age band
            #   dis_imputed codes: 0 = observed, 1 = child imputed, 2 = child 0-2 set to 0, 3 = adult imputed

            impute_children <- TRUE   # FALSE = leave children's missing disability as NA
            impute_adults   <- TRUE   # FALSE = leave adults' missing disability as NA

            .SurvDisability <- function(data_in, ctr_code,
                                        impute_children = TRUE,
                                        impute_adults   = TRUE,
                                        seed = 2026) {
              # start with deep copy
              data_out <- copy(data_in)
              data_out[, dis_imputed := 0L]

              # ---- children (0-15) ----
              if (impute_children) {
                data_out[, child_band := cut(age_dv, c(-1, 4, 9, 15), labels = c("0_4", "5_9", "10_15"))]

                # observed rates among children who did answer, by sex and age band
                # (computed before ages 0-2 are set, so those zeros don't affect them)
                rates_child <- data_out[age_dv >= 0 & age_dv <= 15 & sex %in% c(1, 2) & !is.na(ind_disability),
                                        .(p = mean(ind_disability), n = .N), by = .(sex, child_band)]
                cat("\nObserved child disability rates used for imputation:\n")
                print(rates_child[order(sex, child_band)])

                # ages 0-2: no disability question asked; treat as not disabled
                n_infants <- data_out[age_dv >= 0 & age_dv <= 2 & is.na(ind_disability), .N]
                data_out[age_dv >= 0 & age_dv <= 2 & is.na(ind_disability),
                         `:=`(ind_disability = 0L, dis_imputed = 2L)]

                # ages 3-15 without a valid answer: impute from observed rates
                need_child <- data_out[age_dv >= 3 & age_dv <= 15 & sex %in% c(1, 2) & is.na(ind_disability),
                                       .(pidp, sex, child_band)]
                need_child <- merge(need_child, rates_child[, .(sex, child_band, p)],
                                    by = c("sex", "child_band"), all.x = TRUE)
                if (anyNA(need_child$p)) stop("No observed disability rate for some sex/age groups of children")

                set.seed(seed)
                need_child[, imp := rbinom(.N, 1, p)]
                data_out[need_child, on = "pidp", `:=`(ind_disability = i.imp, dis_imputed = 1L)]

                cat("Set to not disabled (ages 0-2): ", n_infants, " children.\n", sep = "")
                cat("Imputed from observed rates (ages 3-15): ", nrow(need_child), " children.\n", sep = "")
              }

              # ---- adults (16+) ----
              if (impute_adults) {
                data_out[, adult_band := cut(age_dv, c(15, 24, 34, 49, 64, Inf),
                                             labels = c("16_24", "25_34", "35_49", "50_64", "65p"))]

                rates_adult <- data_out[age_dv >= 16 & sex %in% c(1, 2) & !is.na(ind_disability),
                                        .(p = mean(ind_disability), n = .N), by = .(sex, adult_band)]
                cat("\nObserved adult disability rates used for imputation:\n")
                print(rates_adult[order(sex, adult_band)])

                need_adult <- data_out[age_dv >= 16 & sex %in% c(1, 2) & is.na(ind_disability),
                                       .(pidp, sex, adult_band)]
                need_adult <- merge(need_adult, rates_adult[, .(sex, adult_band, p)],
                                    by = c("sex", "adult_band"), all.x = TRUE)
                if (anyNA(need_adult$p)) stop("No observed disability rate for some sex/age groups of adults")

                set.seed(seed + 1)
                need_adult[, imp := rbinom(.N, 1, p)]
                data_out[need_adult, on = "pidp", `:=`(ind_disability = i.imp, dis_imputed = 3L)]

                cat("Imputed from observed rates (adults 16+): ", nrow(need_adult), " adults.\n", sep = "")
              }

              # ---- summary ----
              cat("\nDisability by imputation status:\n")
              print(data_out[, .N, by = .(dis_imputed, ind_disability)][order(dis_imputed, ind_disability)])
              n_left <- data_out[is.na(ind_disability), .N]
              if (n_left > 0) cat("Still missing (e.g. invalid age or sex): ", n_left, "\n", sep = "")

              # reduce & return
              data_out <- copy(data_out[, .(hidp, pidp, new_var = ind_disability, imp_flag = dis_imputed)])
              setkey(data_out, hidp, pidp)
              # tidy variable names
              data.table::setnames(data_out, old = c("new_var", "imp_flag"),
                                   new = paste0(ctr_code, c("_ind_disability", "_ind_disability_imputed")))
              # explicit return
              return(data_out)
            }

            # run and merge back (outside the function)
            dt_dis <- .SurvDisability(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "EW",
                                      impute_children = impute_children,
                                      impute_adults   = impute_adults)
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_dis[, !"hidp"], by = "pidp", all.x = TRUE)
            
        # c13.2 Ind Disability Sim
            .SurvDisabilitySim <- function(data_in, ctr_code, seed = 123) {

            data_out <- copy(data_in)

            # recoding: apply probabilities
            dt_prob_dis_as <- data.table::fread("Input/Survey/pred_grid_dis_age_sex.csv")
            data_out <- merge(data_out, dt_prob_dis_as, by = c("sex", "age_dv"), all.x = TRUE)

            set.seed(seed)
            data_out[, ind_disability_sim := NA_integer_]
            data_out[!is.na(prob_disability_as),
                     ind_disability_sim := rbinom(n = .N, size = 1, prob = prob_disability_as)]

            # ages 0-2 are not in the grid: treat as not disabled, as in P1
            data_out[age_dv >= 0 & age_dv <= 2 & is.na(ind_disability_sim), ind_disability_sim := 0L]

            if (anyNA(data_out[age_dv >= 0, ind_disability_sim])) {
              warning(sum(is.na(data_out[age_dv >= 0, ind_disability_sim])),
                      " people aged 0+ still have no simulated disability")
            }

            data_out <- copy(data_out[, .(hidp, pidp, new_var = ind_disability_sim)])
            setkey(data_out, hidp, pidp)
            data.table::setnames(data_out, old = "new_var",
                                 new = paste0(ctr_code, "_ind_disability_sim"))
            return(data_out)
            }

            # function call: EW
            dt_extracted <- .SurvDisabilitySim(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "EW")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

        # c13.3 Ind Disability x sex x age (uses the imputed EW_ind_disability)
            .SurvDisabilitySexAge <- function(data_in, ctr_code) {

            data_out <- copy(data_in)

            sex_age_col <- paste0(ctr_code, "_ind_sex_age")
            dis_col     <- paste0(ctr_code, "_ind_disability")

            # combine; any missing part gives a real NA so Criteria 2 can catch it
            data_out[, ind_sex_age_disability := fifelse(
              is.na(get(sex_age_col)) | !(get(dis_col) %in% c(0, 1)),
              NA_character_,
              paste0(get(sex_age_col), "_", fifelse(get(dis_col) == 1, "dis1", "dis0"))
            )]

            data_out <- copy(data_out[, .(hidp, pidp, new_var = ind_sex_age_disability)])
            setkey(data_out, hidp, pidp)
            data.table::setnames(data_out, old = "new_var",
                                 new = paste0(ctr_code, "_ind_sex_age_disability"))
            return(data_out)
            }

            # function call: EW
            dt_extracted <- .SurvDisabilitySexAge(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "EW")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))
```
