```{r recode us_hh, echo=FALSE}
        # c14 Ind Activity

            .SurvActivity <- function(data_in, ctr_code) {
            
            # start with deep copy
            data_out <- copy(data_in)

            # general recoding
            data_out[,  jbstat := as.character(jbstat)]
            data_out[jbstat %in% c("-1", "-2"), jbstat := NA]
            data_out[jbstat == "1",  jbstat := "self_employed"]
            data_out[jbstat %in% c("2", "5", "14", "15"),  jbstat := "employed"]
            data_out[jbstat == "3",  jbstat := "unemployed"]
            data_out[jbstat == "4",  jbstat := "retired"]
            data_out[jbstat == "6",  jbstat := "looking_after_home"]
            data_out[jbstat == "7",  jbstat := "student_ft"]
            data_out[jbstat == "8",  jbstat := "lts_disabled"]
            data_out[jbstat %in% c("9", "10", "11", "12", "13", "97"),  jbstat := "activity_other"]
            data_out[age_dv <= 15, jbstat := "activity_not_applicable"]
            
            # recode part time & full time
            data_out[,  jbft_dv := as.character(jbft_dv)]
            data_out[jbft_dv %in% c("-7", "-8", "-9"), jbft_dv := NA]
            data_out[jbft_dv == "1",  jbft_dv := "ft"]
            data_out[jbft_dv == "2",  jbft_dv := "pt"]
        
            
            # EW
            if (ctr_code == "EW"){
                # no action required
            }
            
            # reduce & return
            data_out <- copy(data_out[, .(hidp, pidp, new_var = jbstat)])
            setkey(data_out, hidp, pidp)
            
            # tidy variable names
            data.table::setnames(data_out, old = "new_var",
                                new = paste0(ctr_code,"_ind_activity"))
            
            # explicit return
            return(data_out)
            } 

            # function call: EW
            dt_extracted <- .SurvActivity(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "EW")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))
            
            # ----- # 

        # c15 Deprivation count # 
            .SurvDeprivation <- function(data_in, ctr_code) {
            
            # start with deep copy
            data_out <- copy(data_in)
            
            # start setting flags based on UK Census Bedroom Standard 
            # c1 adult couple
            data_out[, couple_flag := as.numeric(0)]
            data_out[kinship1 %in% c("husband_wife", "partner_cohabitee", "civil_partner"),
                                    couple_flag := 0.5]
            data_out[kinship2 %in% c("husband_wife", "partner_cohabitee", "civil_partner"),
                                    couple_flag := 0.5]
            data_out[kinship3 %in% c("husband_wife", "partner_cohabitee", "civil_partner"),
                                    couple_flag := 0.5]
            data_out[kinship4 %in% c("husband_wife", "partner_cohabitee", "civil_partner"),
                                    couple_flag := 0.5]
            data_out[kinship5 %in% c("husband_wife", "partner_cohabitee", "civil_partner"),
                                    couple_flag := 0.5]
            data_out[, housing_c1 := as.numeric(0)]
            data_out[, housing_c1 := sum(couple_flag, na.rm = TRUE), by = c("hidp")]

            # c2 any remaining adult (aged 21 years or over) 
            data_out[, remaining_adult_flag := as.numeric(0)]
            data_out[couple_flag == 0 & age_dv >= 21, remaining_adult_flag := 1]
            data_out[, housing_c2 := as.numeric(0)]
            data_out[, housing_c2 := sum(remaining_adult_flag, na.rm = TRUE), by = c("hidp")]
            
            # c3 to c8 children -> simplified UK Bedroom Standard for Children ("0.5 per unit")  
            data_out[, remaining_children_flag := as.numeric(0)]
            data_out[(age_dv < 18) & !(kinship1 %in% c("husband_wife", "partner_cohabitee", "civil_partner")) & 
                                    !(kinship2 %in% c("husband_wife", "partner_cohabitee", "civil_partner")) & 
                                    !(kinship3 %in% c("husband_wife", "partner_cohabitee", "civil_partner")) & 
                                    !(kinship4 %in% c("husband_wife", "partner_cohabitee", "civil_partner")) & 
                                    !(kinship5 %in% c("husband_wife", "partner_cohabitee", "civil_partner")),
                                    remaining_children_flag := 0.5]
            data_out[, housing_c3 := as.numeric(0)]
            data_out[, housing_c3 := sum(remaining_children_flag, na.rm = TRUE), by = c("hidp")]
            
            # initialize basic bed requirement and compare against number of bedrooms
            data_out[, bed_requirements := as.numeric(0)]
            data_out[, bed_requirements := as.integer(hsbeds) - 
                                        round((housing_c1 + housing_c2 + housing_c3 + 0.01),0)]
            data_out[, deprivation_housing_hh := 0L]
            data_out[(heatch == 2) | (bed_requirements <= -1),
                                    deprivation_housing_hh := 1L] 
            
            # employment dimension
            data_out[, deprivation_employment_hh := 0L]
            data_out[, deprivation_employment_flag := 0L]
            data_out[(jbstat == 3 | jbstat == 8), deprivation_employment_flag := 1L]
            data_out[, deprivation_employment_count := sum(deprivation_employment_flag),
                                    by = c("hidp")]
            data_out[deprivation_employment_count >= 1, deprivation_employment_hh := 1L]
            
            # health dimension -> poor health, LTS or disability/longstanding condition
            data_out[, deprivation_health_hh := 0L]
            data_out[, deprivation_health_flag := 0L]
            data_out[scsf1 == 5 | jbstat == 8 | health == 1, deprivation_health_flag := 1L]
            data_out[, deprivation_health_count := sum(deprivation_health_flag),
                                    by = c("hidp")]
            data_out[deprivation_health_count >= 1, deprivation_health_hh := 1L]
            
            # education dimension
            data_out[, deprivation_education_hh := 0L]
            data_out[, deprivation_education_flag := 0L]
            data_out[(hiqual_dv == 5) | (hiqual_dv == 9), deprivation_education_flag := 1]
            data_out[deprivation_education_flag == 1 & ((age_dv >= 16 & age_dv <= 18) & jbstat == "student_ft"),
                                    deprivation_education_flag := 0]
            data_out[, deprivation_education_count := sum(deprivation_education_flag),
                                    by = c("hidp")]
            data_out[deprivation_education_count >= pno_max, deprivation_education_hh := 1L]
            
            # sum up
            data_out[, hh_deprivation := as.character(NA)]
            data_out[, hh_deprivation := paste0("hh_deprivation_0",
                                deprivation_housing_hh + deprivation_health_hh + 
                                deprivation_education_hh + deprivation_employment_hh)]

            # reduce & return
            data_out <- copy(data_out[, .(hidp, pidp, new_var = hh_deprivation)])
            setkey(data_out, hidp, pidp)
            
            # tidy variable names
            data.table::setnames(data_out, old = "new_var",
                                new = paste0(ctr_code,"_hh_deprivation"))
            
            # explicit return
            return(data_out)
            } 

            # function call: SCOTLAND
            dt_extracted <- .SurvDeprivation(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "SCO")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

            # function call: EW
            dt_extracted <- .SurvDeprivation(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "EW")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

            # function call: NI
            dt_extracted <- .SurvDeprivation(data_in = dt_survey, ctr_code = "NI")
            dt_survey <- merge(dt_survey, dt_extracted, by = c("hidp", "pidp"))

### [6] COUNT + FORMAT Individual-Level Characteristics ###

        # Function for Counting and Formatting Individual-Level Constraints  #
        .CountFormatIndividuals <- function(data_input) {
        
        # start with deep copy
        # data_output <- copy(dt_survey_SCO)
        data_output <- copy(data_input)

        dt_extracted <- copy(data_output[, .N, by = .(hidp, ind_sex_age)])
        dt_extracted <- copy(data.table::dcast(dt_extracted,
                            hidp ~ ind_sex_age, value.var = "N", fill = 0))
        new_names <- paste0("ind_sex_age%", names(dt_extracted)[-1])
        setnames(dt_extracted, old = names(dt_extracted)[-1], new = new_names)
        data_output <- merge(data_output, dt_extracted, by = "hidp")

        setnames(dt_extracted, old = names(dt_extracted)[-1], new = new_names)
        data_output <- merge(data_output, dt_extracted, by = "hidp")

                                hidp ~ ind_ethnicity, value.var = "N", fill = 0))

        setnames(dt_extracted, old = names(dt_extracted)[-1], new = new_names)
        data_output <- merge(data_output, dt_extracted, by = "hidp")   

        # disability binary simulated counts # 
        dt_extracted <- copy(data_output[, .N, by = .(hidp, ind_disability_sim)])
        dt_extracted <- copy(data.table::dcast(dt_extracted,
                            hidp ~ ind_disability_sim, value.var = "N", fill = 0))
        new_names <- paste0("ind_disability_sim%", names(dt_extracted)[-1])

### [7] Combine HH and Individual Level Information - Keep One Row Per HH Format ###

        .CountFormatHouseholds <- function(data_input, ctr_code) {
        
        # start with deep copy
        data_output <- copy(data_input)
        
        if (ctr_code == "EW") {
            data_output <- copy(data_output[hhref == 1, 
            .(hidp, hh_region, hh_urban_rural, hh_heating, hh_type 
                # hh_tenure_presence_child,
                # hh_cars_hh_size, hh_beds_hh_size, hh_employment_hh_size, hh_carer, 
                # hh_deprivation
                )])
        }
        
        # Melt to long format (excluding ID and Individual-Level Constraints)
        data_output <- melt( data_output,
        id.vars = "hidp",
        measure.vars = colnames(data_output)[2:length(colnames(data_output))],
        variable.name = "variable",
        value.name = "value")

        # indicate combined cat value 
        data_output[, cat_val := as.character(paste0(variable,"%",value))]

        # Add one-hot column and do not retain the rest
        data_output <- data_output[, .(hidp, cat_val, one = 1)]

        # Create one-hot encoded wide format
        data_output <- data.table::dcast(data_output, hidp ~ cat_val,
                                        value.var = "one", fill = 0)
        
        # explicit return 
        return(data_output)
        
        }

        # Function Call 
        dt_survey_EW1  <- .CountFormatHouseholds(data_input = dt_survey_EW, ctr_code = "EW")

        # merge 
        dt_survey_EW_complete  <- merge(dt_survey_EW1, dt_survey_EW2, by = "hidp")

        # save 
        data.table::fwrite(dt_survey_EW_complete, "Output/Survey/dt_EW_survey.csv")

        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

        }

        hcol <- grep("^hh_type%", names(ex), value = TRUE)
        round(colSums(ex[, ..hcol]) / nrow(ex), 3)

        d1 <- grep("_dis1$", dcol, value = TRUE)
        sum(ex[, ..d1]) / sum(ex[, ..dcol]) # disability prevalence


```
```{r format us_export}
# Format us_export for compass 
    library(data.table)
    dt_survey_e <- fread("Output/Survey/dt_E_survey.csv")

    # Target column order, taken from the example file (header only)
    target_cols <- names(fread("data/England/us_hh_export_e_go_10_no_imputation.csv", nrows = 0))

    # Rename one set of disability columns to the compass format, then select and reorder
    make_export <- function(dt, from_prefix, from_suffix) {
    out <- copy(dt)
    old <- grep(paste0("^", from_prefix, "%"), names(out), value = TRUE)
    new <- sub(paste0("^", from_prefix, "%"), "ind_sex_age_dis%", old)
    new <- sub(paste0("_", from_suffix, "([01])$"), "_dis\\1", new)
    setnames(out, old, new)

    missing <- setdiff(target_cols, names(out))
    if (length(missing)) stop("Missing columns: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

    out[, target_cols, with = FALSE]
    }

    dt_survey_e_real <- make_export(dt_survey_e, "ind_sex_age_disability",     "dis")
    dt_survey_e_sim  <- make_export(dt_survey_e, "ind_sex_age_disability_sim", "dis_sim")

    # Check
    stopifnot(identical(names(dt_survey_e_real), target_cols),
            identical(names(dt_survey_e_sim),  target_cols))

    # Save (fwrite doesn't add a row-number column)
    fwrite(dt_survey_e_real, "data/England/us_hh_export_e_go_10.csv")
    fwrite(dt_survey_e_sim,  "data/England/us_hh_export_e_go_10_sim.csv")
```
